evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet database loading, error handling, and recovery logic in src/wallet/.
rationale: Fails fast on corrupted transaction records instead of triggering an endless full rescan on every startup with an inconsistently loaded wallet. As the author notes, a corrupt record previously caused the wallet to rescan from genesis on every launch while leaving the transaction 'inserted to mapWallet, but not be added to mapTxSpends or any of the conflict tracking or to TXO caching.' Fixing this eliminates a recurring failure loop and establishes a coherent backup-recovery policy for corrupted databases.
